A flow diagram of acid rain formation. On the left, a factory chimney, a gas flare and a car release grey arrows of gases into the sky. The gases rise into a cloud where small droplets form. Rain falls from the cloud on the right onto a scene showing a lake with dead fish, trees with yellowed leaves and bare branches, a house with a rusted corrugated roof and an eroded stone statue.

A biomagnification pyramid for DDT in an aquatic food chain. Four tiers from bottom to top, getting narrower: many tiny plankton at the bottom, several small fish, two larger fish, and one fish-eating bird (an osprey or eagle) at the top. Each tier contains red dots representing DDT, with the dots becoming much denser towards the top. A small inset at the top shows a cracked thin eggshell in a nest.

A flow diagram of a sewage treatment plant from left to right. 1: incoming sewage pipe passing through vertical metal bar screens with rags and plastics caught on them. 2: a long grit channel with sand settling. 3: a rectangular primary sedimentation tank with sludge settling at the bottom. 4: an aeration tank with air bubbles rising through brown liquid (activated sludge), and beside it an alternative circular trickling filter with a rotating spray arm over a bed of stones. 5: a secondary settling tank. 6: a small chlorination unit, then clean water flowing out into a river. Below, a pipe carrying sludge from the tanks to a large closed, dome-topped sludge digester with a pipe releasing biogas to a gas holder, and dried sludge used as fertiliser on a field.
